# SocialHan

> A real-time social platform — posts, threaded replies, direct messages and
> live notifications. Built as an engineering showcase by Ilhan Kazan, not as a
> commercial product.

Web app at https://socialhan.ilhankazan.com, with a companion Android app
distributed directly as an APK.

## Stack

- Backend: Java 21, Spring Boot 3.4, PostgreSQL 16, Flyway, STOMP over WebSocket
- Web: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, TanStack Query
- Mobile: React Native (Expo), sharing the same API
- Infrastructure: Docker on a Hetzner VPS behind Cloudflare, self-hosted with Coolify

## Pages

- [Architecture](https://socialhan.ilhankazan.com/architecture): how the system is put together — layering, real-time delivery, moderation pipeline
- [Download](https://socialhan.ilhankazan.com/download): Android APK with its SHA-256 checksum
- [About](https://socialhan.ilhankazan.com/about): what the project is
- [Privacy](https://socialhan.ilhankazan.com/privacy): privacy policy and KVKK notice
- [Terms](https://socialhan.ilhankazan.com/terms): terms of service

## Notes

- User-generated content sits behind an authentication wall; only marketing and
  legal pages are meaningfully indexable.
- Available in Turkish and English.
